title: Kathleen M. Banke
intro:
Kathleen M. Banke is a judge for Division 1 of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. She assumed office in 2009. Her current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Banke is running for re-election for the Division 1 judge of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. She is on the ballot in the retention election on November 3, 2026.
Banke was appointed in June 2009 by Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger and was sworn in on July 30, 2009.
